statusLine.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if($input){$data=$input|ConvertFrom-Json; $total=$data.context_window.total_input_tokens+$data.context_window.total_output_tokens; $used=$data.context_window.used_percentage; $rem=$data.context_window.remaining_percentage; if($null -ne $used){$totalK=[math]::Round($total/1000,1); $usedR=[math]::Round($used,1); $remR=[math]::Round($rem,1); $fill=[math]::Floor($used/5); $empty=20-$fill; $bar='['+('='*$fill)+('-'*$empty)+']'; Write-Host \"$bar Session: ${totalK}K tokens | Context: ${usedR}% used, ${remR}% remaining\"}else{Write-Host \"Session: $total tokens | Context: --\"}}else{Write-Host 'Tokens: --'}"
